statement: let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); ∀ p k a : ℕ, p.Prime → Nat.Coprime p (2*a) → 0<k → (roots a (p^k)).card = (roots a p).card

plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0056 · Preserve the root count at every good prime power

brief.en: Use the unit derivative 2r for uniqueness of the lifting digit and induct from exponent one.
